sources.note: Accepted: 3 pieces (3 cuts), kind note+instruction; single-language; 3 in a row the source stores in this language only; lengths 71/224/220. Wording, diacritics, protected markers and repetition are unchanged.

issues.note: The fa field holds text in the other language here; it is placed in that language's slot as note with its wording and word order untouched, so nothing is translated or reordered.

layout.note: All 1 sources are placed once, in order: 4 output rows, 0 of them carrying Arabic and Persian together. Piece lengths run 198 code points at the median, so the granularity stays in the manual-v1 range. No fused section labels or crossed pairings were found. Rows were checked against the source in sampled groups by genre and against the corpus-wide statistics for every item.
